title: fix(cuda-graph): address shape-guard warmup regression in capture/replay
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: recent changes to CUDA graph capture/replay with shape guards introduced a regression where warmup trajectories could record invalid graph variants for edge-case sequence length transitions. This resulted in increased latency and occasional kernel launch failures during replay when shape-guard boundaries were crossed by continuous-batching workloads.

What this PR does: fixes graph selection and warmup logic to ensure shape-guarded captures are canonical and stable across variable sequence length transitions. The changes: 1) introduce a deterministic shape-guard key normalization step during capture so equivalent logical shapes map to the same recorded graph variant, 2) add validation and fallback in the replay path to re-capture when a mismatch in expected kernel config is detected instead of attempting a blind replay, 3) tighten concurrent warmup scheduling to avoid races between TTL eviction and replay that could surface invalid state, and 4) add unit and perf tests covering transition scenarios and a small doc note on best-effort warmup guarantees.

Motivation: this regression was observed in canary perf runs (perf-canary/region-us-west) and surfaced in customer workloads using continuous batching with variable request lengths. Without the fix, some dedicated nodes saw 5-15% P95 token latency regressions and rare CUDA kernel errors. The change restores stable warmup behavior and reduces token-latency variance.

Testing: added targeted unit tests (cuda_graph_warmup_test) and an integration perf test that simulates sequence-length transitions under continuous batching. Ran full CI, plus replicated the canary workload locally on a small GPU cluster to validate P95 latency and error-free replays.

Notes: this is a behavioral/regression fix (no model API changes). The change is conservative: when in doubt the code falls back to capturing a fresh graph to preserve correctness.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduced regression with deterministic test case
- [x] Added unit + perf tests
- [x] Ran CI and canary perf validation
- [x] Added small docs note about warmup guarantees
- [x] Added changelog/release note
